name: Swym Wishlist Plus
core: Wishlist for shoppers (multiple and anonymous lists, sharing) with email/SMS automations for reminders, restock and price-drop alerts, POS access for staff and shopper behavior reports.
improvements: Free or low-cost entry plan (Swym starts at $29.99/month with no free tier); Built-in back-in-stock and price-drop emails without requiring an ESP; Wishlist demand analytics to guide restocking and discounts; Gift registry mode for weddings and baby showers

name: Loox ‑ Product Reviews App
core: Collects photo and video product reviews automatically (emails, QR codes, discounts) and shows them in on-brand visual widgets, with AI sorting, highlights, translations and syndication to Shop App, Google and Meta.
improvements: Much cheaper paid plan than $49.99/month with no per-order overage; Flat unlimited pricing for growing stores; Video review collection optimized for mobile with in-browser recording; Free import and migration from Loox to lower switching cost

name: Appikon ‑ Back In Stock
core: Collects waitlist signups on out-of-stock products and automatically sends back-in-stock email/SMS alerts on restock, with demand reporting.
improvements: Cheaper paid entry than $19.99/month; Predictable SMS pricing instead of $0.05-$0.40 per message by length; Klaviyo/Shopify Email sync of waitlist contacts; Restock prioritization report ranking products by waitlist demand

name: BOOSTER AI SEO + AEO OPTIMIZER
core: Continuously scans the store and automatically fixes SEO issues: image compression, broken links, meta tags and structured data, plus LLMs.txt and AI-oriented meta for visibility in ChatGPT/Gemini.
improvements: Lower entry price than $39/month; Clear audit log and one-click undo of every automatic change; Measurement of AI-assistant visibility (mentions in ChatGPT/Gemini answers); Explain fixes in plain language for non-technical merchants

name: Avada AI SEO Image Optimizer
core: Audits and fixes store SEO automatically: image compression and ALT text, meta tags, structured data, sitemaps, broken links/404 redirects and page-speed tweaks, with AI-generated fixes.
improvements: Cheaper entry plan than $34.95/month for small catalogs; Transparent before/after reports tied to Search Console data; Safe rollback of every automated change; Focus on AI search visibility (AEO) as the main feature rather than an add-on

name: BOGOS: Free Gift Bundle Upsell
core: Promotion engine for BOGO, buy X get Y, free gift with purchase (auto-add to cart), bundles, volume/tiered discounts and checkout upsells with customizable on-store widgets.
improvements: Flat pricing without per-order overage charges; Cheaper plan focused only on free gift / GWP; Conflict checker that warns when offers overlap with other discounts; Promotion calendar to schedule and preview seasonal offers

name: UpPromote Affiliate Marketing
core: Runs affiliate and influencer programs for Shopify stores: tracks referral sales via links and discount codes, applies flexible commissions and automates approvals and PayPal payouts.
improvements: Flat pricing without the 1-2% cut of referral sales; Simpler setup focused on small brands with a handful of ambassadors; Payout options beyond PayPal (Stripe Connect, bank transfer, store credit); Lightweight creator vetting included in the cheapest plan

name: Pop Convert ‑ Pop Ups, Banners
core: Popup, banner and smart-bar builder for email/phone capture, announcements and gamified offers, with targeting triggers (exit intent, geo, URL), A/B testing and a template library.
improvements: Native sync to email/SMS tools without extra configuration; Pricing not tied to the Shopify plan tier; Built-in consent and compliance templates per country (GDPR, TCPA); Revenue attribution per popup to show which campaigns actually pay off

name: Zapiet ‑ Pickup + Delivery
core: Lets customers choose in-store pickup, local delivery or shipping with a date and time picker, enforcing delivery zones, rates, time slots and order limits, managed from one dashboard and synced with POS.
improvements: Much cheaper entry plan than $49.99/month for single-location stores; Free trial-friendly plan for pop-ups and small local shops; Driver/route view for merchants doing their own local delivery; Automatic customer reminders on pickup day

name: SearchPie: SEO, Schema & Speed
core: All-in-one SEO manager: JSON-LD schema for rich results, bulk AI meta tags, ALT text and descriptions, speed optimizations, IndexNow and sitemap submission, 404 fixes and Google Search Console monitoring.
improvements: Cheaper entry plan than $39/month for small stores; Clear before/after reporting linking fixes to Search Console traffic changes; Safe, reversible bulk edits with change history; Focus on AI search visibility (AEO/llms.txt) with actual citation tracking; Less upsell-heavy, simpler dashboard for non-experts

name: Kaching Bundles App & Upsells
core: Volume-discount and bundle offers on product pages (percentage, fixed amount or set price, gifts) with a styling builder, revenue dashboard and built-in A/B testing to raise AOV.
improvements: Free plan for small stores instead of free only for development stores; Smart offer suggestions based on store order history; Mix-and-match bundles across collections with inventory-aware limits; Cart and post-purchase placements alongside the product page

name: CW Email Popup Email Marketing
core: Email list growth via popups (exit intent, spin-the-wheel, signup forms) plus email campaigns and automations (welcome, abandoned cart, win-back) for Shopify customers.
improvements: Flat pricing with no usage-based overage charges for subscribers or emails; Popup-only lightweight plan that just syncs to the merchant's existing ESP; Built-in A/B testing of popup offers with revenue attribution; Simpler compliance helpers (double opt-in, consent logging per region)

name: Transcy: AI Language Translate
core: AI translation of the whole store into 147 languages stored natively in Shopify, real-time currency conversion and geolocation-based language/currency switching, with multilingual SEO and Shopify Markets integration.
improvements: Usage-based pricing by words translated instead of region tiers; Human review workflow or professional translation add-on for key pages; Translation quality checks and glossary per market; Clearer handling of third-party app text, a frequent pain point (116 one-star reviews); Focus on translation only, deferring currency to native Shopify Markets

name: FBP | Fast Bundle & Upsell App
core: Creates product bundles and upsell offers (fixed, mix & match, build-your-own, BOGO, free gift, volume discounts, FBT) shown on product pages and applied at checkout, including POS.
improvements: Flat pricing instead of tiers based on monthly bundle sales revenue; Focus on one bundle type with a much simpler setup wizard; Built-in A/B testing of bundle offers and discount levels; Better analytics showing incremental AOV versus cannibalized sales

name: Yotpo: Product Reviews App
core: Collects product and site reviews with photos and videos via in-mail requests and AI prompts, displays them in widgets, and syndicates them to Google (Seller Ratings, Shopping Ads), social and marketplaces like TikTok and Walmart.
improvements: Avoid the huge jump from $15 to $119/month with mid-tier plans; Google product ratings feed and syndication included in cheap plans; Simpler, faster widgets without heavy scripts; Better support and transparent billing, likely sources of 135 one-star reviews; Easy migration that imports existing Yotpo reviews with media

name: Smile: Loyalty Program Rewards
core: Branded loyalty program with points, VIP tiers, referrals and promotions (e.g. 2x points), embedded on product pages, checkout and customer accounts, integrated with Klaviyo and other marketing tools.
improvements: Gentler pricing between $15 (500 orders) and $79 (1,000 orders); VIP tiers and referrals included in the entry plan; Usage-free flat pricing for high-order, low-AOV stores; Built-in reward emails without needing Klaviyo; Niche programs (e.g. B2B/wholesale loyalty or POS-first retail)

name: SEOWILL: AI SEO & AI Blog Post
core: AI SEO and GEO workflow that audits the store, finds keyword and content gaps, generates AI blog posts and optimizes on-page, technical and structured data (FAQ schema, llms.txt) for Google and AI search.
improvements: Brand-voice controls and fact-checking against product data to avoid generic AI blog content; Real AI search visibility tracking (mentions in ChatGPT/Perplexity answers); Pay-per-article pricing instead of monthly plans; Editorial calendar with automatic internal linking to products and collections; Multilingual blog generation for international stores

name: Joy Loyalty Program Rewards
core: Loyalty program with points, referrals, VIP tiers and paid membership, redeemable in cart, checkout and POS, plus automatic rewards for Instagram engagement and wallet passes.
improvements: Flat pricing without per-100-orders overage fees; Ultra-simple setup for small stores with a few preset programs; Clear ROI dashboard comparing members versus non-members; Lower-cost plan that includes VIP tiers

name: Section Store: Theme Sections
core: Library of 700+ plug-and-play theme sections that can be added to any theme and edited in Shopify's native theme editor, plus conversion blocks like quantity breaks, bundles and cart drawer.
improvements: Category-specific section packs (e.g. food, beauty, B2B) with templates for that vertical; One-time purchase per section instead of subscription; Automatic compatibility checks and updates when the theme is upgraded; AI generation of custom sections from a description or screenshot; Performance score per section to prove it is lighter than app-based alternatives

name: Etsy Integration by QuickSync
core: Two-way real-time sync between Shopify and Etsy of inventory, listings and orders, so merchants manage Etsy products and orders from Shopify.
improvements: Flat price instead of paying per extra integration; Bulk listing editor with Etsy-specific fields (tags, materials, production partners) from Shopify; Clear sync log and conflict resolution dashboard; Fee-aware pricing rules to offset Etsy fees automatically
